summary: Kootenai County summit: a log and frame lookout cabin built in 1915 and abandoned in 1939; no source describes what remains now.

facts.status_note: The cabin is gone. No source describes what remains on the site.

access.note: Trail 14 route open to hikers, mountain bikers, horses and motorcycles, per a 1996 guide; check current trail status.

visit.trail_note: A spur off Trail 14 reaches the middle summit at 5,634 feet; Forest Road 406 leads nearly a mile to the trailhead.

notes_for_editor: The 1915 build and 1939 abandonment appear on all four pages, but they trace to firelookout.com, the Forest Lookouts page and a 1996 newspaper hike guide; no Forest Service record was found. The 1929 staffer comes from a book named by Idaho Fire Lookouts and was not checked. The 1922 ranger item names Chilco but not the peak, so it is an 'other' event and not a staffing fact for this summit. The 1996 guide gives 1948 for the North Chilco tower, which conflicts with 1939 in the North record. No source describes what remains today; the 1996 guide describes only a former site. The record kind 'ground' is not stated in any fetched source. Location: record (47.86641, -116.55427) and idaho_fl (47.87129, -116.54964) are about 640 m apart; not resolved here.
